Preparation for EKOPFO

Doctor consultations, examinations and preparation of medical documents for a referral for assessment.

Getting started

Breoris Medical coordinates medical preparation for assessment of a person’s daily functioning (EKOPFO): specialist consultations, necessary examinations, review of existing records and preparation of documents for referral.

The first step is a doctor consultation. The doctor reviews your medical history and reports, assesses whether there are medical indications for referral and identifies any missing examinations or specialist opinions.

Examinations and consultations

If needed, the doctor may recommend consultations with a physician, cardiologist, endocrinologist, neurologist or orthopaedic trauma specialist, ultrasound and other diagnostic examinations. The list is individual and depends on your condition and existing documents.

Follow-up consultation

After the required examinations, the doctor reviews the records, test results and specialist reports again. If medical indications are insufficient, the doctor explains the reasons and recommends next steps.

Documents and referral

Where grounds for referral exist, the doctor brings together medical reports and examination results, checks the completeness of the records and describes health-related functional limitations. The treating doctor responsible for the main condition creates the electronic referral and attaches the necessary medical documents.

The case is then submitted to an expert team. The expert team makes the assessment decision, including any decision on establishing or extending disability status. Document preparation does not guarantee a particular outcome.

Preparation fees

The first consultation is charged at the standard clinic rate. Document preparation for EKOPFO, where medically indicated, costs UAH 5,000–8,000. Confirm the final fee and scope with the clinic before proceeding.

The document preparation fee includes a follow-up consultation, coordination, preparation and submission of documents to the EKOPFO system. Additional examinations and consultations are charged separately. If there are no medical indications, the follow-up consultation is charged at the standard rate.

Sources

Service stages and fees are based on materials supplied by Breoris Medical. Official information on the assessment process: Ministry of Health: documents · Ministry of Health: patient pathway.
